notes.title: Hotfix: draft mode crash
notes.content: Fixed crash in launching draft mode - bug due to interaction with procedural music.

notes.title: Avalog Released!
notes.content: Avalog, the continuous chess game, is out now! Go play a match with some friends :)

notes.title: Avalog Showcase!
notes.content: Come play the demo of Avalog - chess where the pieces aren't stuck to discrete squares, [i]i.e[/i] a bishop can move diagonally 1.5 or 0.2 or 4.312 squares. Feel free to leave any feedback or listen to the developer ramble aimlessly on the stream!
